selection.algorithm: first 30 eligible ascending integer seeds; no LLM or future-response selection
eligibility: Y point-estimate MSE(P) > MSE(E), exact rational comparison
P swaps complete A/B cells in Y; X/Z unchanged
selection.stopping_rule: stop after 30 eligible histories; never inspect H or forecast outcomes
selection.duplicate_policy: unique seeds required; observable-tape duplicates recorded, not outcome-selected away

scope: One distinct formation history; two fixed hypothetical Y profiles per condition. No profile feedback, updates, or live audits.

error.message: Cancellation requested; no further calls dispatched
